I cleared the Punjab Police Sub Inspector exam with Rank 2 (713/800). These three posts share one paper, and its subject part is an aircraft maintenance engineer's syllabus - AME and aeronautical diploma holders are the natural candidates.

PSSSB Advertisement No. 02 of 2024 was published on 14 February 2024; applications ran from 16 February to 11 March 2024, fee by 14 March 2024. Age is counted as on 1 January 2024. This page uses that advertisement and the board's official plan of written examination for the three posts. Our copy of the advertisement is a scan in which the post counts are not legible, so they are not given here.

Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the exam pattern?

Under the official Advt 02/2024 plan - 2 hours 30 minutes. Part A is 50 matric-level Punjabi questions (qualifying, 25 needed). Part B has 40 general questions and Part C 60 subject questions, with 1/4 mark cut for each wrong answer in B and C.

What is in the subject part?

Electrical fundamentals, aerodynamics, electronics and digital techniques, aircraft materials and hardware, gas turbine and piston engines, propellers, instrument and lighting systems, aircraft maintenance regulations (DGCA, CAR) and human factors.

When were these posts last advertised?

In PSSSB Advertisement No. 02 of 2024, with Labour Inspector Grade-I. Its eligibility and pay are on this page.
